configuration.title: Stellaris Language Services
Traces the communication between VSCode and the language server.
Auto-adjust the indentation of pasted PDX code blocks to match the surrounding brace nesting.
Enable CWTools CodeLens. Disable it to eliminate CodeLens background requests in very large workspaces.
Enable CWTools semantic highlighting. Disable it to eliminate semantic-token background requests in very large workspaces.
Delay CodeLens and semantic-token requests after opening or completing code so completion is dispatched first. Set to 0 to disable the delay.
The list of languages to validate localisation for.
The placeholder string used when generating missing localisation strings.
Whether or not to validate vanilla (game installation) files and show their errors. Default off: vanilla files are skipped by background validation and show no diagnostics.
Controls how CWTools localisation diagnostics are filtered.
Do not filter localisation diagnostics.
Hide localisation diagnostics only from the Problems panel; keep them available to language-server and AI diagnostic queries.
Suppress localisation diagnostics completely, including Problems-panel and language-server/AI diagnostic results.

Fold repeated localisation warnings sharing the same code within a file into a single expandable Problems-panel entry; the individual warnings are listed under that entry's related locations. Errors are never folded.
Fold repeated CW274D scripted-definition information into one expandable Problems-panel entry, with each failing call site listed under related locations.
Error codes to ignore, list of IDs
Files to ignore errors from, list of file names
Whether or not to enable experimental features
Debug features for helping write rules
Whether to output diagnostic level logs
Rules source mode. latest pulls remote rules into the local cache; bundled fallback is used only after a failed remote update when it is newer than the cache. manual uses only rules_folder.
Optional custom Git repository URL for remote CWTools rules. Leave empty to use the extension's default rules repository for the active game.
A local rules folder used only when rules_version is manual. Workspace .cwtools folders are not read automatically.
File paths to ignore (not loaded by the language service), list of glob patterns
The location of a vanilla EU4 installation
The location of a vanilla HOI4 installation
The location of a vanilla Stellaris installation
The location of a vanilla CK2 installation
The location of a vanilla I:R installation
The location of a vanilla VIC2 installation
The location of a vanilla CK3 installation
The location of a vanilla VIC3 installation
The location of a vanilla EU5 installation
Optional vanilla/reference data root for Custom/Generic Paradox projects
Additional paths to search for scripted_variables files (for hover tooltips and completions). Add paths to vanilla or mod scripted_variables folders.
Control scroll wheel zoom sensitivity, <1 reduces sensitivity, >1 increases sensitivity
Maximum script file size to load in megabytes (warning, very large files can cause instability or invalid diagnostics)

Correct dynamic-parameter diagnostics (inline_script expansions and scripted effect/trigger/value parameters) with one batched call-site validation before initial results are published. Reduces phantom errors without repeating a full validation for every affected file.
Time budget (ms) for warming dynamic-parameter computed data (scripted effects/triggers, script values, inline scripts) before the first validation pass. 0 means no time limit.
Maximum number of dynamic-parameter entities to warm before the first validation pass. 0 means no limit.

commands.stellarisLanguageServices.ai.co: AI: Fix all validation errors in file
Steam App ID used for Workshop uploads when the mod's game profile has no App ID or the App ID is a placeholder (for example Europa Universalis V). Leave empty to use the detected game.

Filter Workshop uploads through the mod folder's .gitignore and .steamignore files, so ignored files are not uploaded. Version-control and editor metadata (.git, .github, .vscode and similar) is always excluded. Turn this off to upload every file in the mod folder.
Extra .gitignore-style patterns excluded from Workshop uploads, in addition to the mod's own ignore files. Useful for build output or local-only files that no ignore file covers.

Manual model replacement per ship size, used by the "Generate Ship Icon Sheet from Models" command. Each key is a ship size; the value is an entity name or a .mesh path relative to the game root, or a list of them. Entries ending in .mesh are read as paths, the rest as entity names; a non-empty list replaces that size's resolved section chain.
Diagnostic codes or message fragments suppressed in this workspace. The legacy ai.ignoredDiagnostics value is read as a compatibility fallback.
Enrich CWTools diagnostics with localized explanations and related information.
ImageMagick executable used by convert_image_to_dds. Leave empty to use magick from PATH.
ffmpeg executable used by convert_audio. Leave empty to use ffmpeg from PATH.
